pages: Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands at the counting house desk with one hand resting flat on a bound ledger volume. Middle distance: a second open volume, an inkstand, a brass door knob. Background: shelves of ledgers, a window over the market door, grey daylight.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, copies a line onto a ruled fair-copy leaf with one steel-nib pen, ink drying on the nib. Middle distance: the working ledger open, an inkwell, a pen tray. Background: shelves of ledgers, low light from a high window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands on a wooden step and sets one thick fair-copy volume onto a high shelf with both hands. Middle distance: more volumes stacked on the rail, a dust brush. Background: shelves behind the door, high window light.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, sits with one small card in his fingers above the open fair copy, reading it through. Middle distance: an inkwell, the working ledger, a blotter. Background: the shelves of ledgers, grey window light on the wall.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, lays one blank sheet down on a heavy plate of looking glass on the bench and lifts it again. Middle distance: a ruled volume, an ink bottle, a press lever. Background: the counting house bench, daylight from the window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, writes at the desk with one pen, his wrist steadied on a leaf of ruled columns and figures. Middle distance: an inkstand, a blotter, one filled volume. Background: the shelves, cold light from a low window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, writes straight down one ruled column at an even hand, the pen never lifting far from the paper. Middle distance: an inkwell, three filled volumes, a stack of sheets. Background: the shelves, a tall window, morning light.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands at the desk with one finger stopped on a figure in one casting paper, four volumes open around him. Middle distance: a blotting roll, an inkstand, a pen. Background: the shelves, warm lamplight on the wall.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, sits over one small worn sheet covered in figures, a pencil in his hand, working out a sum. Middle distance: the casting paper, a blotter, an inkstand. Background: shelves of ledgers, grey window light above the desk.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, holds one small card over the open volume as a screen and follows the column below it. Middle distance: a lamp, the working ledger, a second volume. Background: the shelves, dark, lamplight on the desk top.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, lays one numbered counterfoil slip from the open counterfoil book on the desk beside the fair copy. Middle distance: the casting paper, an inkstand, a pen. Background: shelves of ledgers, low afternoon light from the window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands at the desk turning one pen slowly between his fingers, waiting, a sheet of figures before him. Middle distance: the open volume, a wooden chair. Background: the shelves, grey evening light, a tall dark window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, works one knife blade under the corner of a written leaf, lifting it from the bound volume. Middle distance: a fresh ruled leaf, removed leaves tied with string, an inkstand. Background: the shelves, lamplight on the desk.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, has one day book open to its inside cover, a finger laid on the writing there. Middle distance: a stack of monthly abstracts, an inkwell, a pen tray. Background: the shelves of ledgers, grey window light on the boards.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, tips one round tin out on the table and lays the monthly abstracts out in a row. Middle distance: the casting paper, a pencil, an inkstand. Background: the counting house table, grey daylight from the window.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, sits with one monthly abstract held flat under his hand, his other hand still on the table. Middle distance: the tin, a pencil, the casting paper. Background: the shelves, low afternoon light across the desk top.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands on the panelled landing with one hand closed round a brass door knob, his knuckles raised. Middle distance: the stair rail, a corridor window, a runner of carpet. Background: the bank corridor, low lamplight on the banisters.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands at the office table with one sheet of figures flat under his palm, his chin level. Middle distance: an inkstand, a pen, a thick bound list. Background: the panelled office wall, low lamplight on the desk.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, copies a minute out word for word into one bound minute book on the back room table. Middle distance: an inkstand, a pen, the proof sheet. Background: the back room window, grey daylight on the boards.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, holds one abstract sheet open on the table, reading the false entry at the foot of it. Middle distance: the minute book, an inkstand, the proof sheet. Background: the shelves, cold morning light on the wall.

Thomas Blatchford, sixteen, hair cut short, his father's coat taken in at the shoulders, stands on a step and pushes one closed volume home with its dated spine facing out. Middle distance: three more volumes on the shelf edge, a wooden step. Background: the shelves behind the door, the window dark.
